document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Chapters 1–5 — Validation Cases

validation_cases.name: bar_notation_parse_and_regenerate
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.2.1 — Bar notation format N H D - M - S L

validation_cases.name: bar_max_length_10mm_less
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.2.4 — bars 10mm and less scheduled max 6m

validation_cases.name: column_link_retention_large_spacing
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.2.2 note 1 — spacing > 150mm: every bar retained
validation_cases.expected_rule: every column bar retained by a link

validation_cases.name: column_link_retention_small_spacing
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.2.2 note 1 — spacing <= 150mm: every other bar retained
validation_cases.expected_rule: every other column bar retained by a link

validation_cases.name: vibrator_access_fail
validation_cases.note: Pass — but in practice should have 75mm/300mm check applied

validation_cases.name: cross_ties_required
validation_cases.rule: Figure 4.2 — free height > 400mm triggers cross ties

validation_cases.name: cross_ties_not_required
validation_cases.rule: Figure 4.2 — free height <= 400mm, no cross ties

validation_cases.name: schedule_bar_length_multiples_of_25
validation_cases.rule: BS 8666 / Section 4.5.1 — lengths in multiples of 25mm

validation_cases.name: schedule_bending_dims_multiples_of_5
validation_cases.rule: BS 8666 / Section 4.5.1 — bending dimensions in multiples of 5mm

validation_cases.name: bar_mark_unique_within_member
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.5.1 / Section 2.5 EDI — same bar mark must not repeat within same member name
validation_cases.scenario: Adding bar mark '1' twice to member 'BEAM 3'

validation_cases.name: hole_trimming_required
validation_cases.rule: Section 3.2.2 — holes > 150mm or > 150x150mm must be trimmed
validation_cases.expected: Must be shown on rebar drawing and trimmed with reinforcing bars

validation_cases.name: hole_not_required_on_rebar_drawing
validation_cases.rule: Section 3.2.2 — holes <= 150mm dia or <= 150x150mm need not be on rebar drawing
validation_cases.expected: No trimming annotation needed on rebar drawing

validation_cases.name: column_base_example_tabular
validation_cases.rule: Section 4.1.1, Table 4.1a — tabular method column base
